semiconductor_relevance: High — IL Technology specializes in non-destructive testing equipment specifically designed for semiconductor wire bonds, which is critical for ensuring the reliability of semiconductor devices.
summary: IL Technology Co., Ltd. develops advanced non-destructive laser bond testers for inspecting the quality of wire bonds in semiconductor applications. Their technology leverages thermal conductivity measurements to provide instant, accurate assessments of bonding conditions, enhancing quality control in semiconductor manufacturing.
capabilities: Non-destructive laser bond testing for gold/copper and aluminum wire bonds
Instantaneous measurement of bonding quality using thermal conductivity methods
Support for large semiconductor bonding inspections, including IGBTs and automotive batteries
Prototype development for through-hole inspection of interposers
